name: AirDC++
description: AirDC++ Web Client is a Direct Connect and ADC file-sharing client with a browser UI. It is aimed at always-on hosts such as NAS devices and home servers, with hub connectivity, sharing, downloading and hashing managed through the web interface.

notes.text: Config and runtime data live in /opt/airdcpp_data; downloads default to /downloads and share to /share. To use host storage after install: pct set <CTID> -mp0 /path/on/host,mp=/downloads and pct set <CTID> -mp1 /path/on/host,mp=/share (or tools/pve/storage-share-helper.sh). On unprivileged LXCs, match host ownership/ACLs to the container UID mapping — do not chmod 777.
Web UI is http://<IP>:5600 (HTTPS defaults to 5601). Direct Connect ports default to 21248/tcp+udp and 21249/tcp; forward or open them if you need active connectivity.
Default login is admin with a random password printed at the end of install. Change it later with: /opt/airdcpp/airdcppd -c=/opt/airdcpp_data --add-user
